# Memorijal d.o.o. — International Repatriation & Cremation Montenegro

> Memorijal d.o.o. is an authorized 24/7 administrative, legal, and case coordination agency (Activity Code KD 82.99) headquartered in Tivat, Montenegro, acting under client Power of Attorney and Civil Mandate (Ugovor o nalogu, čl. 842–863 ZOO CG) and providing nationwide dispatch across all municipalities including Podgorica (KCCG & Embassies), Kotor, Budva, and Bar. The company operates strictly as a case coordination and legal agency; it does not operate an in-house hearse fleet or act as a transport carrier or freight forwarder. All physical cross-border transfers and zinc hermetic soldering are performed via accredited, licensed partner carriers and funeral operators under direct Memorijal case dispatch and supervision. We handle 100% of statutory sanitary permits (Sprovodnica), hermetic zinc coffin soldering (lemljenje), consular clearances, and air/road logistics coordination across Montenegro, Serbia, the EU, UK, and CIS.

## Core Services & 2026 Starting Rates (All 14 Agency Tariffs)
- [Full Services Hub (All 12 Services Across 3 Tiers)](https://memorijal.me/en/services/): Comprehensive overview of all repatriation, municipal burial, legal, B2B GOP, expat estate, and pre-need services under KD 82.99.
- [International Air Cargo Repatriation (IATA Cargo HUM)](https://memorijal.me/en/services/repatriation-air-cargo/): Turnkey air freight from Podgorica (TGD) and Tivat (TIV) airports, including embalming, hermetic zinc coffin sealing, and Air Waybill (AWB) booking — **From €4,900**.
- [Regional & European Road Repatriation](https://memorijal.me/en/services/repatriation-road/): Dispatched certified partner carrier transport across Serbia, Bosnia, Croatia, EU, and Ukraine under direct Memorijal case supervision — **From €2,600 (Regional Overland)** / **From €4,200 (EU & Ukraine Ground Repatriation)**.
- [Turnkey Cremation in Serbia (Belgrade / Novi Sad) with Urn Return](https://memorijal.me/en/services/cremation-serbia/): Since Montenegro has no crematorium, we execute lawful cross-border transfer to Belgrade State Crematorium and return the sealed urn within 3–5 business days — **From €2,200**.
- [Consular & Sanitary Clearance Only (Sprovodnica & Punomoćje)](https://memorijal.me/en/services/legal-consular/): Remote Power of Attorney execution, International Death Certificates (Vienna Form C), and sanitary inspector sealing — **From €450** (Apostille, Sworn Court Translations `Sudski tumač` & Embassy Dossier — **From €250**).
- [Local Municipal Burial Coordination in Montenegro (DOO Komunalno)](https://memorijal.me/en/services/local-burial-coordination/): Bilingual representation under KD 82.99 & Power of Attorney with municipal *DOO Komunalno* enterprises — **From €950**.
- [Boka Bay Sea Ash Scattering Ceremony (Yacht Charter & Eco-Floristry)](https://memorijal.me/en/services/local-burial-coordination/): Chartered vessel ceremony in the Bay of Kotor with eco-floristry and official GPS Coordinates Memorial Certificate — **From €1,200**.
- [Insurer Guarantee of Payment (GOP) Direct Case Management](https://memorijal.me/en/assistance/direct-insurer-invoice/): Cashless family execution for Allianz, AXA, Europ Assistance, Balt & Savitar — **From €0 for family (Direct GOP Billing)**.
- [Family Travel Concierge, Live Farewell Stream & Memorial Catering](https://memorijal.me/en/services/): Airport meet-and-greet, hotel booking, encrypted HD live farewell stream, and reception catering — **From €350**.
- [Expat Estate Clearance, Inventory & DHL Personal Effects Dispatch](https://memorijal.me/en/services/local-burial-coordination/): Documented apartment inventory, lease/utility closure, and insured DHL dispatch of valuables to heirs — **From €490**.
- [Vehicle / Yacht Custody Storage, EU Driver Transfer or Brokerage](https://memorijal.me/en/services/local-burial-coordination/): Guarded parking/marina custody, customs compliance, and licensed driver return to the EU — **From €390**.
- [International Pet Relocation & Veterinary Passport Clearance](https://memorijal.me/en/services/local-burial-coordination/): Emergency pet boarding, microchip/titer clearance, and safe return to family abroad — **From €650**.
- [Pre-Need Lifetime Mandate, Protected Legacy Instructions & Time Capsules](https://memorijal.me/en/services/#pre-need-vault): Lifetime legal directives held under a civil mandate (*Ugovor o nalogu, čl. 842–863 ZOO CG*), protected archive of sealed instructions transmitted to designated heirs strictly upon presentation of an official death certificate, plus scheduled video/letter time capsules — **From €190**.

## Primary International Repatriation Corridors (13 Corridors)
- [Repatriation to the United Kingdom](https://memorijal.me/en/repatriation/to-united-kingdom/): British Embassy Podgorica clearance, Coroner Out-of-England compliance, flights to LHR/LGW/MAN.
- [Repatriation to Germany](https://memorijal.me/en/repatriation/to-germany/): German Embassy Leichenpass, Strasbourg Agreement compliance, Air/Road to FRA/MUC/BER.
- [Repatriation to Switzerland](https://memorijal.me/en/repatriation/to-switzerland/): Swiss Embassy Belgrade / Podgorica Consulate Laissez-Passer pour corps (Leichenpass), BAZG/OFDF customs clearance, Air Cargo HUM to Zurich (ZRH), Geneva (GVA) & Basel (BSL) or road hearse.
- [Repatriation to the Netherlands](https://memorijal.me/en/repatriation/to-netherlands/): Dutch Embassy Belgrade Laissez-Passer voor lijken, Wet op de lijkbezorging compliance, Eurocross / ANWB / SOS International GOP, Air/Road to Amsterdam Schiphol (AMS), Eindhoven (EIN) & Rotterdam (RTM).
- [Repatriation to Sweden](https://memorijal.me/en/repatriation/to-sweden/): Swedish Embassy Belgrade Passersedel för lik, Skatteverket (gravsättningsintyg) clearance, SOS International / Falck GOP, Air Cargo HUM or urn to Stockholm Arlanda (ARN), Gothenburg (GOT) & Malmö (MMX).
- [Repatriation to Norway](https://memorijal.me/en/repatriation/to-norway/): Royal Norwegian Embassy Belgrade Laissez-Passer for lik (Likpass), Tolletaten EEA customs under Gravplassloven, SOS International / Gjensidige GOP, Air Cargo HUM or urn to Oslo (OSL), Bergen (BGO), Stavanger (SVG) & Trondheim (TRD).
- [Repatriation to Russia (Груз 200 в Россию)](https://memorijal.me/ru/repatriation/to-russia/): Russian Consulate Podgorica clearance, transit via Belgrade (BEG) or Istanbul (IST) to Moscow/SPB.
- [Repatriation to Ukraine](https://memorijal.me/en/repatriation/to-ukraine/): Embassy of Ukraine Podgorica permits, diplomatic road transport via dispatched partner carriers or air-road combo.
- [Repatriation & Cremation in Serbia](https://memorijal.me/en/repatriation/to-serbia/): Bilateral Sprovodnica via Dobrakovo/Ranče border checkpoints to Belgrade and Novi Sad.
- [Repatriation to Poland](https://memorijal.me/en/repatriation/to-poland/): Polish Consul Podgorica permit, Starosta authorization, LOT Polish Airlines Cargo HUM to WAW/KRK.
- [Repatriation to France](https://memorijal.me/en/repatriation/to-france/): French Embassy Laissez-Passer Mortuaire, air freight to Paris CDG, Lyon, Nice.
- [Repatriation to Turkey](https://memorijal.me/en/repatriation/to-turkey/): Turkish Embassy Podgorica Cenaze Nakil Belgesi, daily Turkish Airlines flights TGD–IST.
- [Repatriation to Italy](https://memorijal.me/en/repatriation/to-italy/): Italian Embassy Passaporto Mortuario, air/road transfer to Rome, Milan, Bari.

## Hospital Mortuaries & Forensic Centers (Cluster A)
- [Regional Hospital Kotor Mortuary (Opšta bolnica Kotor)](https://memorijal.me/en/mortuary/opsta-bolnica-kotor/): Primary coastal mortuary covering Kotor, Tivat, and Budva.
- [Clinical Center of Montenegro Mortuary (KCCG Podgorica)](https://memorijal.me/en/mortuary/kccg-podgorica/): National forensic pathology (Sudska medicina) and clinical mortuary hub.
- [General Hospital Bar Mortuary (Opšta bolnica Bar)](https://memorijal.me/en/mortuary/opsta-bolnica-bar/): Southern coast clinical mortuary for Bar, Sutomore, and Ulcinj.
- [Meljine Hospital Mortuary (Herceg Novi)](https://memorijal.me/en/mortuary/bolnica-meljine-herceg-novi/): Boka Bay entrance hospital and Institute Igalo catchment.
- [General Hospital Nikšić Mortuary](https://memorijal.me/en/mortuary/bolnica-niksic/): Western and central-northern Montenegro hospital hub.
- [Clinical Hospital Center Berane Mortuary (KBC Berane)](https://memorijal.me/en/mortuary/bolnica-berane/): Northern Montenegro and A1 motorway corridor hub.
- [General Hospital "Danilo I" Cetinje Mortuary](https://memorijal.me/en/mortuary/bolnica-cetinje/): Old Royal Capital and Lovćen catchment hospital.
- [Special Hospital "Vaso Ćuković" Risan Mortuary](https://memorijal.me/en/mortuary/specijalna-bolnica-risan/): National neurosurgery, orthopedic, and trauma referral hospital in Boka Bay.

## Cross-Border Checkpoints & Airport Cargo Terminals (Cluster B)
- [Dobrakovo Border Crossing (Montenegro – Serbia)](https://memorijal.me/en/transit/dobrakovo-serbia/): Primary 24/7 road corridor for Belgrade/Novi Sad cremations and hearse transit.
- [Ranče Border Crossing (Pljevlja – Prijepolje)](https://memorijal.me/en/transit/ranche-serbia/): Western Serbia and Belgrade alternative mortuary corridor.
- [Debeli Brijeg Border Crossing (Montenegro – Croatia / EU)](https://memorijal.me/en/transit/debeli-brijeg-croatia/): Schengen/EU sanitary border entry and Dubrovnik Airport (DBV) corridor.
- [Ilino Brdo Border Crossing (Montenegro – Bosnia & Herzegovina)](https://memorijal.me/en/transit/ilino-brdo-bosnia/): Nikšić–Trebinje cross-border mortuary checkpoint.
- [Sitnica Border Crossing (Herceg Novi – Trebinje)](https://memorijal.me/en/transit/sitnica-bosnia/): Coastal Boka Bay to Herzegovina cross-border checkpoint.
- [Božaj Border Crossing (Montenegro – Albania)](https://memorijal.me/en/transit/bozaj-albania/): Podgorica–Shkodër–Tirana Airport (TIA) corridor.
- [Podgorica Airport Cargo Terminal (TGD Cargo HUM)](https://memorijal.me/en/transit/aerodrom-podgorica-cargo/): Main national IATA Cargo HUM export facility.
- [Tivat Airport Consular & Urn Transit (TIV)](https://memorijal.me/en/transit/aerodrom-tivat-transit/): Coastal cabin urn clearance, private aviation HUM, and TGD feeder.

- [Remote Power of Attorney (Punomoćje) Guide](https://memorijal.me/en/guides/power-of-attorney-repatriation/): How families arrange 100% of procedures remotely without flying to Montenegro.
- [Forensic Autopsy (Obdukcija) & Prosecutor Release Guide](https://memorijal.me/en/guides/autopsy-obdukcija-montenegro/): KCCG Forensic Medicine timelines and preliminary death certificate release.
- [Cinerary Urn Airline Cabin & Customs Rules](https://memorijal.me/en/guides/urn-air-cabin-transport-rules/): X-ray translucent urn specifications and airport security clearance at TGD, TIV, and BEG.
